title: SEC1: download drops IO errors silently
notes: In blob_download_handler (kithd/src/lib.rs line ~171), the error branch is Err(_e) => return (500, 'read error'). The error is bound to _e and discarded; no tracing::error call. A disk I/O error on blob read will produce a 500 with no log entry, making production debugging impossible. Compare: the upload handler correctly logs with tracing::error. Fix: add tracing::error\!(err = ?e, ...) before returning 500.
